title: Python security gate (agentsec)
summary: A dedicated Python security gate that runs agentsec's scanners (bandit, pip-audit, semgrep) + static guards.
notes: Wraps `agentsec audit` rather than re-implementing bandit/pip-audit/semgrep — agentsec already runs those scanners and its dependency-free static guards, normalizing everything into one report. This delivers that as a standalone, à-la-carte Python gate. (The all-in-one audit ships as the agentsec GitHub Action, `action.yml` at the agentsec repo root.)
